Upgrade fastjson 2.8.0 -> 2.9.4 to fix CVE-2026-31337

CVE-2026-31337 (high): unbounded recursion when parsing deeply nested
arrays. Affects fastjson <2.9.4. Fixed in 2.9.4; staying on the 2.x
line to avoid breaking changes from the 3.x major version.

args.body:
## Summary
Upgrades `fastjson` from 2.8.0 to 2.9.4 to remediate **CVE-2026-31337** (high severity): unbounded recursion when parsing deeply nested arrays, affecting fastjson <2.9.4.

## Details
- Pinned to `2.9.4`, the fix version on the current 2.x line, to avoid breaking changes from the 3.x major version (3.1.0 also fixes it but is a major upgrade).
- No source changes required; only `requirements.txt` is modified.

## Testing
- CI run `ci-0001` on commit `c8b8ab7878`: **passed**.

Closes the CVE-2026-31337 exposure in this service.
